quote a price: Before we agreed to repaint the house, we asked the workers to quote a price for the whole job.
在同意重新粉刷房子前，我們請工人為整件工作報價。
quote an expert: The news report chose to quote an expert, who said the earthquake was the strongest in fifty years.
這篇新聞報導選擇引用專家說法，專家表示這是五十年來最強的地震。
quote from a poem: In his wedding speech, the groom chose to quote from a poem about love that his bride enjoyed.
在婚禮致詞中，新郎選擇引用一首新娘喜愛的愛情詩句。
quote out of context: It is unfair to quote a singer out of context, because one short line can change the meaning of her words.
斷章取義地引用歌手的話並不公平，因為短短一句話就能改變她話語的意思。
race against time: The rescue team was in a race against time to find the missing hikers before the storm arrived.
搜救隊在暴風雨來臨前與時間賽跑，搜尋失蹤的登山客。
one's heart races: Whenever I stand on the stage to give a speech, my heart races and my hands start to shake.
每當我站上舞台演講時，我就心跳加速，雙手也開始發抖。
race through the work: Because the boss wanted the report by noon, we had to race through the work without taking a break.
因為老闆中午前就要報告，我們只好不休息地趕工。
race to the hospital: When he heard that his wife was about to have the baby, he jumped in a taxi to race to the hospital.
聽到太太快要生產時，他跳上計程車飛奔去醫院。
the rat race: Tired of the rat race in the big city, he moved to the countryside to grow vegetables.
厭倦了大城市裡的激烈競爭，他搬到鄉下去種菜。
rack one's brains: I had to rack my brains for an hour before I remembered where I had put my passport.
我絞盡腦汁想了一個小時，才記起把護照放在哪裡。
racked with guilt: For years after the car accident, the driver was racked with guilt and could not sleep well at night.
車禍發生後多年，那名司機一直深受罪惡感折磨，晚上無法好好入睡。
rack up points: Our best player managed to rack up points quickly, scoring twenty in the first half of the game.
我們最好的球員迅速累積得分，上半場就拿下二十分。
rack up debts: Young people who use credit cards carelessly can rack up debts that take years to pay back.
隨便刷信用卡的年輕人可能會累積要花好幾年才還得清的債務。
go to rack and ruin: Nobody has lived in the old house for twenty years, so it has begun to go to rack and ruin.
那棟老房子二十年沒人住了，所以已經開始荒廢。
rage against injustice: The young writer used her novels to rage against injustice and speak for poor workers.
那位年輕作家用她的小說怒斥不公，為貧窮的工人發聲。
the storm raged: The storm raged all night, knocking down trees and leaving the whole town without electricity.
暴風雨肆虐了一整夜，吹倒樹木，讓整個小鎮停電。
the debate rages on: Years after the law was passed, the debate rages on, with strong opinions on both sides.
法律通過多年後，這場辯論仍激烈持續，雙方都有強烈的意見。
all the rage: Bubble tea was all the rage among teenagers that summer, and new shops opened on every street.
那年夏天珍珠奶茶在青少年間風靡一時，每條街都開了新店。
raid the fridge: Whenever I study late at night, I get hungry and quietly raid the fridge for something to eat.
每當我熬夜念書時，肚子就會餓，然後偷偷突襲冰箱找東西吃。
police raided the house: Early in the morning, the police raided the house and found thousands of fake bills hidden in the walls.
清晨時分，警方突襲搜索房屋，發現牆裡藏了數千張假鈔。
raid the savings: When the car suddenly broke down, we had to raid the savings we were keeping for our vacation.
車子突然拋錨時，我們只好動用原本留著度假用的存款。
raid a village: In the old story, pirates would sail to the island and raid a village, stealing food and gold.
在古老的故事裡，海盜會航行到島上襲擊村莊，搶走糧食和黃金。
raise a question: Her strange behavior at the party seemed to raise a question in everyone's mind about what was wrong.
她在派對上的奇怪舉動似乎讓每個人心中都提出一個問題：到底出了什麼事。
raise awareness: The students made posters to raise awareness about the danger of plastic waste in the ocean.
學生們製作海報，以提高大眾對海洋塑膠垃圾危害的意識。
raise children: It costs a lot of time and money to raise children in a big city like Taipei.
在像台北這樣的大城市養小孩要花很多時間和金錢。
raise one's voice: Our teacher never needs to raise her voice; one look from her makes the whole class quiet.
我們老師從不需要提高嗓門；她看一眼就能讓全班安靜下來。
raise the bar: The new smartphone has a much better camera, and it will raise the bar for all other phone makers.
這款新手機的相機好得多，將為所有其他手機製造商提高標準。
raise eyebrows: His decision to wear shorts to the formal wedding was enough to raise eyebrows among the guests.
他決定穿短褲參加正式婚禮，這足以讓賓客們側目。
raise an objection: If anyone wants to raise an objection to the plan, please speak now before we vote.
如果有人想對這項計畫提出異議，請在我們投票前現在說出來。
